mapper.insert: MERGE INTO studio_terms_agreement t USING (SELECT #{memberId} AS member_id, #{termsCode} AS terms_code, #{termsVersion} AS terms_version FROM dual) s ON (t.member_id = s.member_id AND t.terms_code = s.terms_code AND t.terms_version = s.terms_version) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (member_id, terms_code, terms_version) VALUES (s.member_id, s.terms_code, s.terms_version)
